name: Bottom-up Neighbor-Finding Ray Traversal
aliases: Octree-based Ray Tracing with Neighbor Finding
definition: A ray tracing implementation that uses an octree representation of a scene. Rays are traced by calculating the blocks through which they pass using a bottom-up neighbor finding approach, rather than top-down traversal.
summary: Bottom-up neighbor-finding ray traversal efficiently steps through octree cells by using neighbor lookups instead of hierarchical descent, trading implementation complexity for traversal speed.
